content: The word vectors used in all of our experiments were produced by word2vec using the skip-gram model with 20 negative samples, a context window size of 10, a minimum token count of 3, and sub-sampling of frequent words with a parameter of INLINEFORM0 . We extracted corpus statistics for word2vec using the AFP portion of the English Gigaword, which consists of 887.5 million tokens. The code used to generate the results is available at http://www.github.com/xyz, and the evaluation datasets are publicly available.
